gstHstCredit.timingNote: Estimated annual entitlement generated by this tax year's adjusted family net income. Cash is paid in the following July–June benefit year, not during the tax year itself.

canadaWorkersBenefit.timingNote: Refundable tax credit for this tax year (line 45300). Advance payments may be issued in the following July–January cycle; this calculator reports the annual entitlement on the return, not cash timing.
canadaWorkersBenefit.excludedProvincesNote: Quebec, Alberta, and Nunavut use province/territory-specific Schedule 6 parameters. Those jurisdictions are not modeled here.
canadaWorkersBenefit.disabilitySupplementNote: CWB disability supplement is excluded. Eligibility requires Disability Tax Credit approval, which this calculator does not collect.

canadaChildBenefit.timingNote: Estimated annual entitlement generated by this tax year's adjusted family net income. Monthly payments run July following the tax year through June of the year after.
canadaChildBenefit.childDisabilityBenefitNote: Child disability benefit is excluded. It requires Disability Tax Credit approval for the child.
canadaChildBenefit.sharedCustodyNote: Shared custody (typically 50% of the calculated amount per CRA rules) is not modeled. Enter only children for whom the filer would receive the full entitlement.

provincialPrograms.note: Provincial and territorial income-tested benefits (for example Ontario Trillium Benefit / sales tax credit, BC Family Benefit, SK low-income tax credit) are not modeled in this version.
